_readme: GENERATED ILLUSTRATIONS — step 3 of the picture rule (CEO, 2026-08-08: 'free source first, then AI generated images, we are not paying for images'). Wikipedia lead image, then the article's own body image, then this. Every entry is credited as an illustration and never presented as a photograph of the real thing.
_rule: NEVER generate a likeness of a real person, a copy of a real artwork, or an imitation of a living cultural tradition. A fabricated portrait of Maryam Mirzakhani would be misinformation on a product whose whole proposition is verified truth; an imitation Papunya Tula dot painting would appropriate art that is owned. Where the subject is a person, a work or a tradition, the illustration shows the SUBJECT MATTER instead and the alt text says so.
_generated: 2026-08-14 via Higgsfield nano_banana, 2 credits each on the existing plan. Downloaded, resized to 480px and stored in img/gen/ so no card depends on an external CDN staying up.
